name: LLM Grammar
description: Improve and polish the selected text using LLM. Hold Shift (⇧) to copy just the response.
note: To use this extension you will need access to an OpenAI compatible LLM API service, such as OpenAI

options.label: Default API Endpoint
options.description: The OpenAI compatible API endpoint for all languages

options.label: API Endpoint for Chinese 中文
options.description: The API endpoint for an LLM specialized in Chinese

options.label: API Endpoint for Korean 한국어
options.description: The API endpoint for an LLM specialized in Korean

options.label: API Key
options.description: The API key for the endpoint (for OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys). Leave empty if the endpoint does not require one.
